title: Tap graph node events from the blessed host executor
narrative: Fangore’s console needs live path lighting as a durable plan runs. They want the same short host wiring used for submit-once jobs — not a second hand-built executor — and still receive node start and end events for the active steps. Complements `fangore_host_kit_submit_once` and feeds console zoom stories such as `fangore_conversational_tool_loop`.[^june-hf05-insp]
implementation: `mechaharness.host_kit.host_graph_executor` accepts `event_log=`. `tapping_event_log` / `TappingEventLog` forward emits to a host callback while preserving query. `CliInstrumentor` stamps then taps the blessed executor log so consoles see `core:graph_node_start` / `core:graph_node_end` on the same path as CLI infer (HF-05).
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `tapped_node_lifecycle.yaml`: hard `tapped_event_types_exactly` includes node start/end (and full tap order). Unit: `tests/test_conversational_tool_loop.py` (tap used with tool-loop runner).
